clue.text: Tax on clubs with hard liquor

parts.note: scot is an old word for a tax, as in scot-free
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A duty is levied on golf clubs along with strong drink.
explanation.walkthrough: SCOT survives in 'scot-free', meaning without paying the tax.
explanation.definitionFit: Scotch is whisky distilled in Scotland, a strong spirit.

parts.note: read not as a short, squat container but as one made to hold cigarette stubs

explanation.definitionFit: A dish for cigarette ends and ash is the container smokers grind their stubs into.

clue.text: Both wise and ignorant need shade

parts.note: a sage is a wise person, and sage also means wise
green means inexperienced or naive

explanation.surface: Someone who is at once clever and naive needs to be kept out of the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Sage green is a soft grey-green colour, a shade named after the herb's leaves.

clue.text: Man in boat seeing part of island

definitions.meaning: One of the narrators in Jerome K. Jerome's comic novel Three Men in a Boat
... is the southern part of the Hebridean island of Lewis and ..., off Scotland

explanation.definitionFit: The same name fits a character in a famous boating novel and a district of a Scottish island.

clue.text: Equality I found in political organisation

indicators.note: the letter is discovered sitting inside the word for the organisation, so it is placed within it

parts.note: a party is an organised political group

explanation.surface: A politician claims to have discovered fairness within their own party.
explanation.definitionFit: Parity means being equal in status, pay or value.

clue.text: Not hurting for father to be out more?

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
being out more is the same as being in less, so the phrase gives IN LESS

explanation.surface: A child wonders whether things would hurt less if Dad were away from home more often.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful step: being out more means being IN LESS, so father (PA) plus IN LESS spells the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something painless causes no discomfort at all.

definitions.meaning: ... as an adjective means correct or fitting
something one is entitled to

explanation.definitionFit: The word serves both as an adjective for correct and as a noun for a legal claim.

definitions.meaning: to ... a matter is to think it through thoroughly
the total amount of money a business takes in sales

explanation.definitionFit: As a phrasal verb it means to consider; as a noun it means a company's gross revenue.

clue.text: No players available for Robinson Crusoe?

definitions.text: No players available for Robinson Crusoe?

parts.words: No players available for Robinson Crusoe?
parts.note: the cast (the players) being away, so not available, describes the marooned hero of Defoe's novel

explanation.definitionFit: Robinson Crusoe is the classic shipwrecked sailor stranded alone on an island.

definitions.meaning: to finger something is to touch or handle it
fish ... are breaded strips of fish

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for touching with the hands and the name of breaded fish strips.

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word it is read backwards

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone complains that the real issue is the levy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns IT into TI; the apostrophe-s is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A tithe was a tenth of one's produce or income paid to support the church.

indicators.note: breaking the words up and putting the pieces together differently signals a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Ending an affair in order to be alone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Break' scrambles the nine letters of LIAISON and TO.
explanation.definitionFit: Being cut off from others is a state of being alone.

parts.note: sh is the call for silence
y is an unknown quantity in algebra

explanation.surface: A description of someone silent, mysterious and cautious.
explanation.definitionFit: Being shy of something means being cautious of it.

parts.note: not dark patches on the sun's face but spots on the skin caused by the sun

explanation.definitionFit: Prickly red skin pimples brought on by hot weather are caused by the sun.

definitions.meaning: a shoot growing from a plant's root or stem
a gullible person, easily cheated

explanation.definitionFit: Botanically it is a new growth from the root; informally it is a dupe.

clue.text: Drunken cry of support for European?

definitions.meaning: slang for drunk, or befuddled
fans shout 'up the' team, so a cheer for a person from Poland

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is slang for tipsy or muddled, and also sounds like a supporter cheering on a Polish person.

definitions.meaning: ... Jane was the nickname of the American frontierswoman Martha Jane Cannary
a great misfortune

explanation.definitionFit: The Wild West heroine's nickname and the ordinary word for a catastrophe are the same.

definitions.meaning: to ... someone on is to urge them
something eaten

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb (egg on) it means urge; as a noun it is a breakfast staple.

parts.note: not a pleasant officer but one from Nice, the city on the French Riviera

explanation.definitionFit: A French police officer of the national force, such as one serving in Nice.

parts.note: taken as written
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning quietly

explanation.surface: A simile: as silent as a serpent.
explanation.definitionFit: An asp is a small venomous Egyptian viper.

clue.text: Gorge as artist brings supply of grapes

parts.note: RA stands for Royal Academician, an artist
a vine is the plant that bears grapes

explanation.surface: A painter turns up with a grape crop in a narrow valley.
explanation.definitionFit: A ravine is a deep narrow valley with steep sides.

clue.text: Sash is a little too big

indicators.note: only a small portion of the phrase is used, so the letters sit inside the words

explanation.surface: A complaint that a belt is slightly oversized.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across tOO BIg.
explanation.definitionFit: An obi is the broad sash worn with a Japanese kimono.

clue.text: Move impatiently, given only fraction of pint?

definitions.meaning: to stride off in an angry or impatient way
..., a fluid ounce, is one twentieth of an imperial pint

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means storm off; split as fl ounce it is a small liquid measure.

parts.note: not about the Dutch language: 'old Dutch' is Cockney slang for a wife, so a man without one

explanation.walkthrough: 'My old Dutch' is British slang for one's wife, from the music-hall song.
explanation.definitionFit: An unmarried man is one without a wife.

clue.text: It may hold firm by a fluke

definitions.text: It may hold firm by a fluke

parts.words: It may hold firm by a fluke
parts.note: not holding by luck: a fluke is the pointed blade of a ship's mooring device that digs into the seabed

explanation.definitionFit: A ship's heavy iron hook grips the seabed with its flukes to keep the vessel in place.

indicators.note: the vehicle is spotted inside the word for decay, so it goes within it

parts.note: rot means decay
a bus is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A tough coach is spotted amid rust and rot.
explanation.definitionFit: Robust means strong and hard to damage.

clue.text: Surprisingly hand reins to Jewish council

indicators.note: the letters end up in an unexpected order, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Someone unexpectedly gives control to a religious assembly.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sanhedrin was the supreme court and council of ancient Israel.

parts.note: a hind is a female red deer

explanation.surface: A hunter takes something from a deer to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Hindi is a language, and tongue is a word for language.

definitions.meaning: to measure the depth of water with a weighted line
... means precisely, as in ... in the middle

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means sound the depth; as an adverb it means squarely or exactly.

clue.text: Organ is playing for foreign lady

indicators.note: playing suggests the words being played about with, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: An organ performs for a visiting woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is playing' looks like one verb, but only 'playing' signals the anagram; 'is' is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Signora is the Italian title for a married woman, the equivalent of Mrs or madam.

definitions.meaning: to collect is to gather things
short prayers in Anglican and Catholic liturgy

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means gathers; the noun names short set prayers said in church.

indicators.note: the word it is placed inside the word for the fire

parts.note: a pyre is a heap of wood for burning, a fire

explanation.surface: An instruction to throw a rock into the flames.
explanation.definitionFit: Pyrite, fool's gold, is an iron sulphide mineral.
